scenarios.expected_outcome: Stops update process and returns error reporting the missing software part binary

title: Requirements in this chapter are mainly raised due to dependencies to HSM and other related security mechanisms.

scenarios.description: Verify HSM security interface dependency validation design is compliant
preconditions: HSM dependency requirements are detailed and active
scenarios.action: Validate HSM and security interface interaction
scenarios.expected_outcome: Granular verification tests map successfully to HSM access and security restrictions

scenarios.description: Verify update behavior when HSM security configuration is incorrect
preconditions: HSM dependency configuration is incorrect
scenarios.action: Attempt to execute SW Update
scenarios.expected_outcome: Security mechanisms block flash operation and raise appropriate security errors

scenarios.description: Handle HSM dependency querying during security state transition
preconditions: HSM security state is in transition
scenarios.action: Query HSM dependencies during transition
scenarios.expected_outcome: System handles security state transition gracefully without deadlocking or failing

title: With activated HSM the update handler shall request PFLASH or SWAP UCB access from HSM, before SW update is started.

scenarios.description: Request and obtain PFLASH/SWAP UCB access successfully with active HSM
preconditions: HSM is active
Update handler is initialized
scenarios.action: Start SW update process
scenarios.expected_outcome: Update handler requests and successfully obtains PFLASH or SWAP UCB access from HSM before beginning transfer

scenarios.description: Fail to start SW update when PFLASH/SWAP UCB access request is denied by HSM
preconditions: HSM is active
Update handler fails to request or is denied access to PFLASH or SWAP UCB by HSM
scenarios.action: Start SW update process
scenarios.expected_outcome: Update process is blocked, does not start, and exits with security/access violation error

scenarios.description: Handle timeout of PFLASH/SWAP UCB access request to HSM
preconditions: HSM is active
PFLASH/SWAP UCB access request to HSM times out
scenarios.action: Start SW update process
scenarios.expected_outcome: Update handler handles timeout gracefully, aborts SW update start, and logs access timeout error

Proxy side is active
Secpol mechanism is enabled
Authorized credentials are provided

Proxy side is active
Secpol mechanism is enabled
Unauthorized or missing credentials
scenarios.action: Attempt to execute a CLI command.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Command execution is denied and a security error is returned.

preconditions: System is initializing
Proxy side is starting up
Secpol configuration is empty or corrupt
scenarios.action: Attempt to initialize the proxy and access the CLI.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Proxy initialization fails or access is completely blocked (fail-secure state).

title: An interface for production diagnosis shall be provided, to execute a bank sw...

scenarios.description: Verify bank swap execution via the production diagnosis interface without validity checks.
preconditions: System is in production diagnosis mode
UCB security disabling steps have been performed
The production diagnosis interface is accessible
scenarios.action: Trigger bank swap command via the production diagnosis interface.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Bank swap is executed immediately without performing any validity checks.

scenarios.description: Verify production diagnosis bank swap interface is inaccessible directly after production when UCB security is active.
preconditions: System is in post-production state
UCB security is fully active
UCB security disabling steps have not been performed
scenarios.action: Attempt to access the production diagnosis interface to trigger a bank swap.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Access to the interface is denied and no bank swap is executed.

scenarios.description: Verify system behavior when a second bank swap request is triggered while a bank swap is already in progress.
preconditions: System is in production diagnosis mode
UCB security disabling steps have been performed
A bank swap operation is currently active and incomplete
scenarios.action: Trigger a second bank swap command via the production diagnosis interface.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The system rejects or serializes the duplicate request, maintaining system integrity.
